name: t4_patient_dns_c2
label: true_positive
description: A patient intrusion using a valid service account, a payload side-loaded into a signed process, and command and control over DNS at a low rate with jitter, sustained across weeks rather than hours.
detectable_as: The beacon's regularity over a long window, and a signed process resolving names it has no business resolving. Neither is visible in a day of data.
why_hard: Volume is indistinguishable from noise at any single point. A search window of thirty days floors a campaign that ran longer, and rarity scoring reads a valid account on its usual host as normal. This is the case that breaks products tuned on tiers 1 and 2.
